evidence.observation: Flow dropped from ~100 sccm to ~54-57 sccm for k=118-121 (t=3005-3020 s) then recovered over ~15 s, while setpoint stayed at 100
Tube pressure fell in lockstep to ~2.58-2.62 Torr during the same window, consistent with a real flow interruption rather than a sensor fault
Temperature drifted ~755->763->750 °C early in growth but settled at setpoint; cooldown proceeding normally with Pheat~0

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/SEM) of the sample, and MFC valve-position/diagnostic logs to confirm whether the ~20 s Ar dropout was an MFC fault versus an upstream supply glitch.
